parts.text: Drones fly along corridors between named sites, and sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time. Authorities define zones where flying is prohibited and announce planned closures with a start and end time, sudden closures that apply at once, and amendments during the day. Radio coverage is patchy, reports from drones can arrive late or out of order, and drones sometimes restart in flight after a software fault and carry on.
